reason: Reproduced with installed uv 0.12.13 on Linux x86_64, Python 3.12.3, using isolated temporary state and a local index containing releases ten days and one day old. With global exclude-newer = "3 days", `uv tool install cooldown-demo` installed 1.0.0. Changing the global setting to false, then running `uv tool upgrade --all` and `uv tool upgrade --all --reinstall`, retained 1.0.0 and the receipt's P3D policy. Explicit `--exclude-newer false` upgraded to 2.0.0 without preview locks. With UV_PREVIEW_FEATURES=tool-install-locks, disabling or removing the global setting retained P3D in both receipt and lockfile. Receipt timestamps advanced in that mode, so the unchanged-timestamp claim is only partly reproduced. The CLI override cleared preview metadata but did not upgrade; a fresh installation selected 2.0.0. The exact reported uv 0.13.0/macOS/Python 3.15 environment was not tested. Saved-setting persistence is documented; distinguishing inherited from explicit settings remains a design question. Updated $RUNNER_TEMP/issue-context/README.md with commands, evidence, test coverage, and limitations. No checkout or GitHub changes were made.
